component.name: Aurales
component.summary: Discover, track, and play movies and series

description.p: Aurales is a desktop media hub with multi-provider watch tracking, mood-based discovery, Stremio addon support, and native mpv playback.

Introduces a refined responsive design system with fluid typography, cinematic floating navigation, artwork-aware ambient colors, consistent glass and interaction states, accessible custom controls, scalable media shelves, and stronger cross-platform behavior.

Adds a consistent responsive desktop layout from compact windows to 4K and ultrawide displays, adaptive navigation and player controls, mpv picture-quality profiles, decoded-audio recovery, safer smart stream fallback, and improved fixed Home shelf presentation.

Adds ranked and feature poster rows, inline trailer previews, TorBox debrid support, Stremio library synchronization, a redesigned Watch Together experience, resilient personalized Discovery, and in-app update installation for AppImage and standalone Flatpak packages.
Adds local watchlists, multi-provider watched-state checks, themed Watch Together improvements, player diagnostics, keyboard shortcuts, and a redesigned search experience with cast and crew results.
Improves release playback reliability and introduces coordinated, cache-first network traffic for faster browsing and safer addon usage.
Bundles the complete native Linux media runtime, improves NVIDIA hybrid-GPU rendering, and repairs AniList desktop authentication.
Improves Linux playback, interface polish, and release packaging.
